name: manual_813caf
claim: For mutable GitHub PR or issue text, define the canonical logical representation at the actual transport boundary before hashing: JSON serialization can preserve a trailing LF inside a string, while printf may add one and Bash command substitution may remove trailing LFs. Use exact bytes for Git blobs, tracked files and binary transport; do not attribute shell or CLI loss to JSON.

decisions.notes: Accepted after verifying the precise representation boundary: JSON strings preserve an LF; printf adds the helper LF and Bash command substitution removes trailing LFs. The new accepted record corrects the causal explanation while retaining the original exact-byte-versus-logical-text distinction.
